parsed.rationale: Both `TestPerson` (CacheCoordinatorTests.swift:71) and `CachedPerson` (CachedFetchTests.swift:257) are type-alias-objects living inside the `Caching` package's test directory (`Shared/Caching/Tests/CachingTests/`). Although neither record carries `is_test=true` in its context flags, both files are unambiguously test fixtures by path convention (`Tests/CachingTests/`). The two aliases serve distinct test suites — coordinator tests vs. fetch tests — and their structural coincidence (shared_field_count: 2, no differing_slots reported) reflects the simplicity of a Person-shaped stub rather than meaningful shared logic. Merging or extracting them would couple two independent test files for no production benefit.
